verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a SaaS compliance case-management platform, so contracted processing region and cross-border data handling is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents data residency, deployment regions, or cross-border transfer terms. The 'validate cases against a given jurisdiction' item concerns regulatory filing jurisdiction, not where data is processed, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can verify the contracted processing region and cross-border handling for the chosen deployment
